title: 75 small freight firms met before the scheme was built: 15 in each of five markets
unit: number of small freight forwarding firms interviewed, one mark for each firm
footnote: IAG Cargo interviewed 15 small freight forwarding firms in each of five markets before building its loyalty scheme, which launched in March 2017. 75 is our sum of those. In each firm the owner drew up the list of airlines and junior clerks made the day-to-day choice. Source: the IPA Effectiveness Awards paper, 2018.
